title: The deploy smoke: the built candidate serves and answers healthy
description: The batch gate's smoke before any deploy: the candidate, built and served in the private trial container, answers GET /healthz?ready&strict with 200, healthy and ready, and with an owner recorded its merge commit is authored 'NAME (Mainworks) <EMAIL>' while the merge writer, mainworks-merge-writer, stays the committer, an owner change strands no work in flight, and what a person reads says Mainworks. Every head a batched merge trial lands is on a candidate this smoke gates.

steps.name: warm builds and commits take turns with deploy exports; a second install reuses the tag (GY-4077)
a deploy holds its heavy-job slot across a lease-error retry, which runs without build cache (GY-4047)
a stand-in install move builds its trial image only when the target starts (GY-4048)
install move leaves the sandbox mask file behind, refuses an unreadable file before changing anything and undoes a failed copy (GY-4043)
the flow numbers show each repository's onboarding time, connection to first merge (GY-4059)
unchanged registry observations write no receipts and real changes replay once (GY-4036)
the image-lock tests finish in 30 s on their own lock directory, never the shared host lock (GY-4040)
a database well under its bound shows no database warning, and health names its size and largest tables (GY-4005)
with an owner recorded, the merge commit is authored 'NAME (Mainworks)'
an owner change keeps in-flight work completable and a running session authors with the new owner
what a person reads says Mainworks, the merge writer commits as mainworks-merge-writer
mainworks lead is the command with master kept as a hidden alias in help and guide topics (GY-4050)
a repository past the scan budget still scans, so its install can update
the README is the approved text, its commands and links resolve, and it recommends a dedicated server without a fixed price
the getting-started guide is the approved text with short bullets and both captures, and the reference holds the detail
low Docker space reclaims only unused Mainworks images and old dedicated build cache
code review and product review of one head run side by side (GY-3963)

installs take turns building, even while another holds the host image lock (GY-4052), a warm image send takes its turn with a deploy build (GY-4053), and a repeated bad blob recovers without clearing shared cache
